// P5 fixture corpus — type descriptor / witness-table suffix module-aware output.
//
// Fix P5: descriptorPrintOpts implements module-aware qualification for the
// N (type metadata), M* (descriptor/accessor/metaclass), and W* (witness table)
// runtime-record suffixes:
//
//   • Foundation module  → full qualified: "Foundation.TypeName"
//   • Swift stdlib types (S<X> substitution) → full qualified: "Swift.TypeName"
//   • Swift concurrency types (Sc<X> substitution) → simplified: "TypeName"
//   • All other modules  → simplified: "TypeName" (module prefix stripped)
//
// All expected outputs verified against Apple swift-demangle 6.3.

// ── "main" module: simplified (N / Mn / Ma suffix) ───────────────────────────

$s4main3FooVN ---> type metadata for Foo

$s4main3FooVMn ---> nominal type descriptor for Foo

$s4main3FooVMa ---> type metadata accessor for Foo

$s4main3FooVMp ---> protocol descriptor for Foo

// ── Combine: simplified ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierVN ---> type metadata for CombineIdentifier

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierVMn ---> nominal type descriptor for CombineIdentifier

$s7Combine0A10IdentifierVMa ---> type metadata accessor for CombineIdentifier

// ── Foundation: qualified ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorVN ---> type metadata for Foundation.CocoaError

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorVMn ---> nominal type descriptor for Foundation.CocoaError

$s10Foundation10CocoaErrorVMa ---> type metadata accessor for Foundation.CocoaError

// ── Swift stdlib (S<X>): qualified ────────────────────────────────────────────

$sSiMn ---> nominal type descriptor for Swift.Int

$sSaMa ---> type metadata accessor for Swift.Array

$sSiMf ---> metaclass for Swift.Int

// ── Swift concurrency (Sc<X>): simplified ─────────────────────────────────────

$sScAMp ---> protocol descriptor for Actor

$sScTMp ---> protocol descriptor for Task

$sScCMn ---> nominal type descriptor for CheckedContinuation

$sScEMa ---> type metadata accessor for CancellationError

// ── Witness table / accessor (W* suffix): simplified for non-Foundation ───────

$s4main3FooVWP ---> protocol witness table for Foo

$s4main3FooVWa ---> protocol witness table accessor for Foo

$s4main3FooVWo ---> method descriptor for Foo
